Context: . 7. Reservations for Ex-Servicemen

It also includes a person who retired, or was released on medical grounds or due to reduction in the establishment, or was released after completing the specific period of engagement.  
Short Service Commissioned Officers released from service after completing initial terms of engagement otherwise than by way of dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency and have been given gratuity shall be eligible to the status of Ex-servicemen.  
- Notification, dated 13-2-2020.
